anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals (1, 5, 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck issues.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, which may indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration.
Trading system has a total profit/loss (PL) of 0 and no active trades, suggesting inactivity or potential issues with strategy execution.

Evaluate the effectiveness and configuration of active trading strategies to ensure they are operating as intended.
